message.content: Based on the conversation, Gavriel expresses a preference for turn-based combat. He mentions that he really enjoys games that offer strategic depth, as seen in titles like "Persona 5 Royal." Gavriel finds satisfaction in the thoughtful nature of turn-based battles, appreciating the time to consider and plan moves, and he values the depth it offers in battles. This preference for turn-based combat aligns with his enjoyment of games that require careful consideration and planning, as opposed to real-time strategy games.
